'''Drone craft''' were communication devices used to transport physically recorded messages through the [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==History==
Drone craft were used to carry messages before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were considered antiquated by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a group of traitorous [[Imperial officer/Legends|imperial officers]] used a drone craft to communicate discretely with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and propose them an [[Mission to Fondor (Galactic Civil War)|arrangement]].
